3look_606846.name: 3look
3look_606846.description:
3look is an AI-based application that allows users to create and publish content for social networks, mainly memes and GIF images, with the ability to post directly on platforms like X (formerly Twitter) for results-based rewards.

It represents a content creator studio where users generate branded or custom content using AI tools for quick ideas, face-swapping to NFTs or crypto assets, and publishing, while the AI evaluation system transparently assesses impact, distributing revenue without constant engagement.

Designed as a SocialFi project on ApeChain within the ApeCoin ecosystem, it turns user-created content into reward-generating blockchain assets, with partnerships expanding to networks like Ice Open Network for decentralized social layers.

activities.title: Public Alpha Waitlist
activities.description:
3look announced Public Alpha! You can connect your X account and wait for access to the platform. The higher your score, the faster your application will be approved.

1. Go to the website and connect your X account
2. Enter your email
3. Invite friends to boost your score

activities.title: First Campaign: The Loop Season 1
activities.description:
3look announced the launch of the first campaign The Loop Season 1. If you have access to the public alpha, you can share a pool of 30,000,000 3look points that will be used for future rewards and benefits.

1. Go to the website, enter your email and connect your X
2. Open the "Campaigns" tab and start completing tasks

arc-circle.name: Arc Testnet
arc-circle.description: Circle, the leading issuer of the USDC stablecoin, launched a public testnet for the Arc blockchain, available to everyone. This testnet is primarily for developers, but several unofficial applications already allow making transactions in the Arc test network. We can interact with them and potentially claim an airdrop from the project.

activities.title: Arc Testnet
activities.description:
Arc launched the testnet! First of all, this testnet is for developers, but several unofficial apps already allow making transactions in the Arc test network. We can interact with them and potentially claim an airdrop.

1. Request test tokens USDC and EURC in Arc and Ethereum Sepolia testnets from the faucet
2. Go to Curve and make a few swaps
3. Mint a domain on Infinityname
4. Bridge tokens, make swaps and add liquidity on Defi on Arc
5. Send GM and deploy on OnChainGM and zkCodex
6. There are also several NFTs on the Arc network on unverified sites. DYOR

activities.title: Tasks on Superboard
activities.description:
Superboard announced a campaign where we can additionally interact with the Arc testnet.

1. Go to the website and complete the tasks

action_model_229125.name: Action Model
action_model_229125.description:
ActionModel is developing a community-owned Large Action Model (LAM) — an AI system designed to perform real digital tasks on computers by interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUIs), rather than just generating text like traditional Large Language Models (LLM). It monitors screen states, makes decisions about actions (such as clicking coordinates, typing text, or scrolling) using its own action tree built on user contributions, executes these actions, and loops until the task is completed.

The project fights centralized AI development by major tech companies through community contribution: users install a browser extension for passive or active learning and create/sell reusable workflows on a marketplace where execution rewards creators with ongoing payments.

activities.title: Points Farming
activities.description:
Action Model announced the launch of extension and platform for training AI-agents. You can participate in training by simply installing the browser extension and going about your usual activities on the internet.
On the Action Model platform, in the ActionFI section, you can complete quests on various platforms and earn points

1. Go to the website and register with email
2. Open the "Get Started" tab, complete available tasks and install the extension
3. Go to the "Quests" tab and complete available tasks. There's a daily check-in
4. In the "ActionFi" tab, complete tasks. Completing tasks from this tab gives you points with a multiplier

activities.title: TaskOn
activities.description:
Campaigns with quests for training and content creation are available on the TaskOn platform. By completing quests, you earn LAM points. These points reflect your contribution to the project and may later be converted to tokens or affect airdrop allocation size.

1. Go to the website, connect your wallet. Start completing quests

aztec_249126.name: Aztec
aztec_249126.description: Aztec Network is a private ZK-rollup on Ethereum that allows decentralized applications to access privacy and scaling. The Aztec rollup is secured by the industry's standard PLONK verification mechanism, used by leading scaling projects with zero-knowledge.

activities.title: New Testnet
activities.description:
Aztec announced a new testnet launch

1. Go to the website, connect wallet and request test tokens
To receive test tokens, you need verification with ZKPassport
2. On the staking website, connect your wallet and click "Stake", then send your preferred amount of test tokens to staking

activities.title: Aztec Node (Testnet)
activities.description:
Aztec launched testnet! One of the main activities within the testnet is node installation.

1. Install the Aztec node using one of the guides: official or unofficial (more beginner-friendly)

robinhood_382133.name: Robinhood Chain
robinhood_382133.description:
Robinhood is a stock broker that allows customers to buy and sell stocks, options, ETFs and cryptocurrencies with zero commission.

The startup offers trading in stocks, cryptocurrencies, and options, as well as money management accounts. It also provides a stock broker platform that democratizes access to financial markets and aims to make it convenient for people to store money and trade stocks through its app.

activities.title: Testnet
activities.description:
Robinhood announced the launch of L2 network. You can participate in the public test network among the first and mark yourself as an early user, which will give you an advantage when interacting with ecosystem products launched on Robinhood Chain

1. Open the faucet website and request test tokens
2. Go to the documentation website and click on the wallet you use, connect it and add the Robinhood network
3. Request test tokens in Sepolia network from one of the available faucets
4. Open the bridge and connect your wallet. Transfer funds from Sepolia network to Robinhood network
5. Go to OnChainGM website, connect your wallet. Find Robinhood Testnet in search and click the buttons
6. Open NFTs2Me, switch to Robinhood Testnet, fill in the fields, upload an image and click "Deploy to Robinhood Chain Testnet"

activities.title: Edel Finance
activities.description:
Edel Finance announced inclusion of Robinhood Chain in their testnet. You can participate in testing Edel Finance and add another protocol to your wallet statistics

1. Request test tokens
2. Open Edel Finance page and connect wallet
3. Choose an asset and perform various actions

tempo_980866.name: Tempo
tempo_980866.description: Tempo is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 (L1) blockchain designed for payment processing. It doesn't replace general-purpose blockchains but offers solutions for high-volume payment scenarios including predictable low fees, various stablecoin support, built-in stablecoin exchange, high throughput, low latency, private transactions, payment memos with standards support like ISO 20022, and compliance mechanisms.

activities.title: Tempo Testnet
activities.description:
Tempo launched the testnet! We can interact with the test network and become early users. Transactions can only be made on unofficial sites (created by third-party developers), so DYOR!

1. Go to the website, connect wallet, add Tempo test network to it and request test tokens
2. Periodically send test tokens to other wallets
3. Send GM and deploy on onchaingm
4. Buy a domain in Tempo test network
5. Connect wallet and create a stablecoin
6. Create a test token and add liquidity
7. Make several swaps

activities.title: Tasks on Superboard
activities.description:
Superboard announced a campaign where we can additionally interact with the Tempo testnet.

1. Go to Superboard and complete the tasks

activities.title: Tempo Node
activities.description:
Another way to interact with Tempo project is to install a node. This requires a server with certain requirements.

1. Go to the link and install the node following the official guide
